hooks.command: if [ -x "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.venv/Scripts/python.exe" ]; then PY="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.venv/Scripts/python.exe"; elif [ -x "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.venv/bin/python" ]; then PY="$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/.venv/bin/python"; else PY=python3; fi; exec "$PY" "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/tools/agent/hooks/guard.py" --agent-types t3-matcher
